response.text: Starting the 15th, on-call will move to two-week rotations across the engineering org. This reduces handoffs, improves continuity, and gives owners more uninterrupted time to investigate and resolve issues. The updated on-call schedule is posted in the usual place—please review your assignments and raise any conflicts with your manager or reply to this email. We'll gather feedback after the first cycle to refine the process. Thanks for your flexibility as we roll this out.
